report: Read all 27 verses end to end, including the added units the candidate table cannot see. No construction is analysed two ways without the ASV licensing the difference.
Waw+לא → Neither is fused and headed on the negative in v3, v6, v17; v18 gives Neither to the waw alone because the negative is gapped there (rule 35). Consistent.
כל היום → all the day long is one treatment in v8, v15, v22: all→כל, the→ה, day long→יום with the supplied long joining the noun (rule 31); corpus has 11 'day long' units on יום.

זנח → cast ... off with the supplied object us added in both v9 and v23 (rule 44); למה → why/Wherefore fused on מה in v23 and v24; for ... sake headed on sake for both על (v22) and למען (v26); the dative ל before a bare English object is unrepresented in v1, v3, v26 and takes for only where the ASV writes it (v10).
